about: Exact layout of the Dash Arena (MAP_HAN_WILD_AREA) in the Hän FireRed hack, build 2026-11-26m. Coordinates are tile (x, y), origin top left, x right, y down. The map is 86 x 86 tiles, border of 2 x 2 rock tiles.

files_in_rom.tiles: data/layouts/HanArena/map.bin (86*86 little-endian u16 words, row by row)

metatile_word: word = metatile_id | collision << 10 | elevation << 12. Primary tileset gTileset_HoennGeneralSnow (ids 0-511), secondary gTileset_HoennArena (ids 512+).

snow, walkable (0x3001, or a tree tip 0x3202/0x3203 where a tree is directly below)
class_legend.T: tree, solid. Whole 2x2 trees: canopy 0x1D4/0x1D5 over 0x1DC/0x1DD, trunk-only 0x0604/0x0605 when nothing is below
class_legend.~: river water, surfable (0x1170 plain, or one of 25 shore tiles chosen by neighbours)
class_legend.R: ruins cobblestone, walkable (0x3200). Barracks are single R tiles; ancients are 3x3 R patches
class_legend.Q: stone pillar, solid (0x0601). Towers are single Q tiles; each ancient has one Q in its middle
class_legend.K: cave entrance around the Roshan pit (6 tiles, x 26-28, y 29-30; the warp tile is 0x0A7 at elevation 3). No warp event yet

ancients.shape: 3x3 R patch with Q in the centre

towers_and_barracks_note: what: T1 T2 T3 are Radiant towers from outer to inner, T1D T2D T3D are Dire towers, bar is the Radiant barracks and barD the Dire one. One lane entry each: top, mid, bot.
objects_note: item balls (ITEM_BALL), cut trees (CUT_TREE), rock smash rocks (ROCK_SMASH_ROCK) and strength boulders (PUSHABLE_BOULDER). Item balls use scripts HanArena_EventScript_Item0..11 in data/scripts/han_arena.inc: per side Rare Candy, Nugget, Max Revive, Full Restore, PP Up, Ultra Ball.
camps_note: Each member is a wild Pokémon sprite made in src/han_wild.c (not a map object). Species are drawn on every visit from the land pool sPool; level = highest party level - 8 (small), +0 (medium), +5 (large), clamped 5-100; species whose lowest possible level (src/data/han_camp_levels.h) is above that level are dropped.
